title: Cohen-Macaulayness with locally Noetherian fibres is fppf local on the target and syntomic local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the property of having locally Noetherian fibres and being Cohen-Macaulay is local in the fppf topology on the target and in the syntomic topology on the source. The proof reduces the two locality statements to the corresponding behaviour of the Cohen-Macaulay property under faithfully flat and syntomic base change and then reassembles them, so the content is the assembly of the local conditions rather than a new construction. Retained author proof at lines 6109-6148.
